images.title: Counting squares
images.purpose: Show a triangle on a grid of 1 cm squares with its 6 whole squares and 4 half squares marked, so that two half squares are seen to make one whole square.
images.composition: The grid with the triangle on the left, a small key on the right.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. At the top, centred at x 728 and y 62, the heading Counting squares in dark #1F2937 bold sans-serif (44 px). LEFT, a grid of 5 columns by 5 rows of unit squares, every square 80 by 80 px with thin grey #6B7280 grid lines (2 px), spanning x 140 to 540 and y 150 to 550, white inside. On it a right triangle with its right angle at the top left corner of the grid, at (140, 150), whose two straight sides each run 4 squares, along the top grid line to (460, 150) and down the left grid line to (140, 470), with the third side joining those two points. The 6 whole squares inside the triangle are filled amber #E69F00: in row 1 the squares at x [140, 220, 300], in row 2 the squares at x [140, 220], in row 3 the square at x [140] (row 1 is the top row). The 4 half squares, each the part of a square below the third side, are filled teal #0072B2: one in each of rows 1, 2, 3 and 4, at the square positions x [380, 300, 220, 140] and y [150, 230, 310, 390]. The triangle has a thin dark #2B2B2B outline (4 px). RIGHT, a key: one square of 80 by 80 px at x 760 to 840 and y 190 to 270, filled amber with a thin dark outline, with the caption 1 square cm to its right at x 940, y 230 (36 px, dark #1F2937); below it, at x 760 and y 360, a small amber square of 40 px with the caption 6 whole squares to its right (36 px); below that, at x 760 and y 440, a small teal triangle of 40 px with the caption 4 half squares to its right (36 px). In all 25 grid squares, 6 whole squares, 4 half squares and 3 keys. No other number and no other text anywhere. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
a triangle with a number of whole squares other than 6 or of half squares other than 4
any area, sum or answer written anywhere in the frame
images.takeaway: Count the whole squares, put the half squares in pairs, and add: the area is the number of unit squares.
images.description: A triangle on a grid of 1 cm squares: 6 whole squares in amber and 4 half squares in teal.
images.context: Concept image for The Unit Square and Counting Squares. It follows the idea of the grids in your maths book (a unit square, whole squares and half squares) and uses the numbers of this concept's own example.
images.teaching_notes: Let the student colour or point at the whole squares first, then the half squares in pairs. The slip to watch: counting a half square as a whole one.

image_decisions.why: The triangle on the grid makes 'two half squares make one square' visible.
